text:
jamie: Rain on the windows + long-ish coding session tonight. Throw me one playlist and one micro-book (<=180 pages) rec pls. Prefer something cozy/not-sad. :umbrella:

zoe: try Nick Drake 195697170s vibe3 tracks 1 hour -> pair with "The Collected Short Stories" (Sherwood Anderson) ? short pieces, mellow. :guitar:

marcus: For cozy but upbeat: Yo La Tengo I Can Hear the Heart Beating as One + "The Little Prince" for a quick, heartwarming read. :star2:

emma: if you want instrumental: Nils Frahm All Melody or his "Spaces" set. pair with an essay-like pocketbook: "On Looking" by Alexandra Horowitz (short).

jamie: Ooh love Yo La Tengo. Anyone got something with a bit more groove (not full dance)?

zoe: Khruangbin again :-). "Con Todo El Mundo" has chill grooves. pair with "The Buddha in the Attic" (Tayari Jones?) (ok that last one is longer, ignore my chaos).

marcus: tiny correction: "The Buddha in the Attic" is by Julie Otsuka and it's ~160 pages, actually fits.

emma: vote time: jamies pick? reactions: :thumbsup: for Yo La Tengo (marcus), :heart: for Nick Drake (zoe), :100: for Khruangbin (zoe too).

jamie: Playlist-bot, can you stitch a 10-track rainy-couch list from Yo La Tengo / Nick Drake / Khruangbin / Nils Frahm, with at least 2 instrumentals?

playlist-bot: Generated playlist "wet-window-10" (10 tracks): https://play.example/pl/wetwindow10. Contains 2 instrumentals. Expires in 7 days.

zoe: link works. i added a suggested order DM to jamie.

marcus: micro-book consensus: "The Little Prince" for tonight. bonus: read aloud at 9pm in kitchen?

emma: i'll bring tea and the tiny fairy lights. jamie, can you bring whisk? (seriously). :tea:

jamie: yes to whisk & tea. meetup 9pm in the kitchen for reading + low-volume listening. thanks for quick recs everyone. :sparkles:
